name: z2ui5_cl_ui5_srv_model::ltcl_test_delta_apply::test_skip_cell_refused
why: ABAP refuses the cell by the DECLARED component type (price TYPE p); a JS row is a plain object where price and a string column both hold text, so the port can only refuse what a JS number rejects. Guessing from the text instead would refuse 'Y' into a string column holding '2', which test_update_second_row asserts must be accepted

why: the superseded z2ui5_if_exit lives in upstream's frozen src/99, which this port excludes by policy (scripts/check-no-frozen.js): upstream keeps it so abapGit installations with an exit written against the old interface keep working, and this package has no such installed base.
